x-openregister._seedDataNote: Seed objects MOVED to lib/Settings/profiles/*.json (OpenSpec change seed-profiles). A register.d fragment declares SCHEMAS ONLY, so installing this app plants zero objects. The examples that used to live here are now part of an example set an operator picks in the first-time setup wizard, which is the only thing that imports them.

TermijnagendaItem.title: TermijnagendaItem
TermijnagendaItem.description: A termijnagenda (long-term agenda / LTA) item: a forward-planned proposal or topic a governance body can expect (raadsvoorstel, raadsinformatiebrief, themabijeenkomst, begrotingsstuk), in which period, owned by griffie/college/portefeuillehouder, optionally originating from a toezegging, motie, or earlier decision, and optionally realised into an actual AgendaItem/Decision. It closes the accountability loop between commitments (toezegging), motion execution (Decision/UitvoeringsUpdate: referenced, NEVER duplicated here) and the meeting agenda, and doubles as a live public transparency instrument via the OpenRegister published-predicate. CONSTRAINT (design D4): this schema contains ONLY publishable fields by construction (no internal-only property; shift reasons are deliberately public). Adding ANY non-public property requires revisiting the public-predicate design in D4, because the whole live object is exposed through the public-group authorization.read rule when publicationDate <= $now.

x-openregister-lifecycle._note: Declarative guarded transition map (ADR-031, REQ-LTA-003). Canonical dialect (keyword 'initial', never 'initialState'/'states'-only/'default' — the silently-ignored drift dialect). gepland → verschoven | gerealiseerd | vervallen; verschoven → verschoven (self-transition allows repeat shifts, REQ-LTA-004) | gerealiseerd | vervallen; gerealiseerd and vervallen terminal. Entering 'vervallen' requires redenVervallen — a data-shape conditional NOT expressible in this transition map nor in the OR 'required' array (which cannot be state-dependent); enforced at the UI layer (vervallen dialog cannot confirm without a reason) and documented on the redenVervallen property (REQ-LTA-003). No app-side state machine.

subject.en: Reminder: termijnagenda item past its planned period — {{onderwerp}}

termijnagendaRappelPeriodeAangebroken._note: Period-arrival rappel (REQ-LTA-008). intervalSec 604800 (weekly) is PROVISIONAL (design open question — provisional 'once at period arrival + weekly while overdue'; griffie-configurable tuning deferred to a future admin-settings change). Filter targets non-terminal lifecycle only (gepland/verschoven) so gerealiseerd and vervallen items never rappel. DIALECT CAVEAT (mirrors the toezeggingen rappel): the 'planned period has arrived AND no realisation link' distinction is a period-last-day-vs-now comparison plus a realisedAgendaItem/realisedDecision null-check that the simple equality filter shape shown here cannot express; the scheduled-notification engine's window semantics must interpret it — verify OR's scheduled-notification engine during live import (open question: exact relative-date token for 'period last day vs now'). Recipients approximate 'owner + griffie' via object-acl (read) + the decidesk-members group, because no recipient kind targets the owner Person reference directly.

subject.title: Subject
subject.description: The expected proposal or topic (subject of the plan). Required.

governanceBody.title: Governance body
governanceBody.description: Reference to the GovernanceBody (council/committee) the item is planned for. Required; drives the per-body board scoping.

plannedPeriod.title: Planned period
plannedPeriod.description: The planned period at month or quarter granularity: quarter YYYY-Qn (n 1-4, e.g. 2026-Q4) or month YYYY-MM (e.g. 2026-11). Required. Free-form text is rejected by this pattern. Sort-key convention (design D2): a period maps to its LAST DAY (2026-11 -> 2026-11-30, 2026-Q4 -> 2026-12-31); chronological order = order by last day; overdue = last day < today AND lifecycle non-terminal AND no realisation link.

expectedType.title: Expected type
expectedType.description: The type of item expected to arrive. Required.

ownerType.title: Owner type
ownerType.description: Who owns delivery of the item. Required. When 'portefeuillehouder', the owner Person reference is required (conditional-required: see owner).

owner.title: Owner
owner.description: Reference to the owning Person (portefeuillehouder). REQUIRED when ownerType is 'portefeuillehouder', otherwise null. This conditional-required rule is NOT expressible in the OR 'required' array (which cannot be value-dependent); it is enforced at save time by the UI and documented here.

notes.title: Note
notes.description: Free-text note explaining the planned item. Optional.

lifecycle.title: Lifecycle
lifecycle.description: Item status (declared in x-openregister-lifecycle, ADR-031): gepland -> verschoven (repeat shifts allowed) -> gerealiseerd | vervallen. gerealiseerd and vervallen are terminal. Entering vervallen requires redenVervallen; a reschedule to verschoven appends to verschuifHistorie.

shiftHistory.title: Shift history
shiftHistory.description: Append-only history of reschedules. Each reschedule appends one entry (previous period, new period, mandatory reason, acting user, timestamp); existing entries are never edited or removed by the reschedule flow. Part of the public record (transparency instrument, design D4). Embedded array, not a separate schema (design D1): a shift has no independent lifecycle and never travels outside its item.

van.title: From period
van.description: The planned period before this reschedule (same pattern as plannedPeriod).

toPeriod.title: To period
toPeriod.description: The planned period after this reschedule (same pattern as plannedPeriod).

door.title: By
door.description: The acting user (Person reference or user id) who performed the reschedule.

reasonExpired.title: Drop reason
reasonExpired.description: Reason the item was dropped (recorded when moving lifecycle to vervallen). REQUIRED when entering vervallen (enforced at the UI layer; not expressible as a state-dependent OR 'required' rule). Optional otherwise.

originCommitment.title: Origin commitment
originCommitment.description: Optional reference to the Toezegging (toezeggingen-ingekomen-stukken) this planned item stems from. Renders as a navigable reference on the detail page. Nullable; degrades to an absent link if that change is not installed.

originMotion.title: Origin motion
originMotion.description: Optional reference to a Decision of decisionType 'motion' (motie-amendement-administratie) this planned item stems from. The execution narrative lives EXCLUSIVELY on that motion's UitvoeringsUpdate log; the termijnagenda never duplicates it. Nullable.

originDecision.title: Origin decision
originDecision.description: Optional reference to an earlier Decision this planned item stems from. Renders as a navigable reference on the detail page. Nullable.

goal.title: Goal
goal.description: Optional reference to the organisation Goal (organisation-goals change) this planned topic serves. Renders as a navigable reference on the detail page (organisation-goals REQ-008). Nullable; existing termijnagenda items created before this change remain valid with no goal set.

realisedAgendaItem.title: Realised agenda item
realisedAgendaItem.description: Reference to the actual AgendaItem that realised this planned item, set (assisted, always user-confirmed) when marking gerealiseerd. The termijnagenda NEVER creates, moves, or modifies agenda items or meetings itself. Nullable; presence means 'realised' for the overdue computation.

realisedDecision.title: Realised decision
realisedDecision.description: Reference to the actual Decision that realised this planned item, set when marking gerealiseerd. Nullable; presence means 'realised' for the overdue computation.

publicationDate.title: Publication date
publicationDate.description: Publication date (WOO/DIWOO). When set in the past, the live item is anonymously readable through the OpenRegister published-predicate (public-group authorization.read rule publicationDate <= $now). Publish is an explicit staff action; because the predicate sits on the live object the public termijnagenda reflects reschedules and lifecycle changes without republication (design D4).

depublicationDate.title: Depublication date
depublicationDate.description: Depublication date (WOO/DIWOO). When set and in the past, the item is withdrawn from public access. Set by staff on withdraw.
